   136	/-- A varying-ambient quotient system has colimit `B / J` when readings exhaust `B`
   137	and membership in `J` is detected by eventual membership in the bounded kernels. -/
   138	noncomputable def directLimitQuotientEquivIdeal
   139	    [DirectedSystem G (f · · ·)]
   140	    (hcover : ∀ b : B, ∃ i : ι, ∃ x : G i, read i x = b)
   141	    (hsaturation : ∀ i (x : G i), read i x ∈ J →
   142	      ∃ j : ι, ∃ hij : i ≤ j, f i j hij x ∈ K j) :
   143	    Module.DirectLimit (fun i ↦ G i ⧸ K i)
   144	        (directedQuotientMapOfCompatible f K hK) ≃ₗ[R] (B ⧸ J) :=
   145	  LinearEquiv.ofBijective
   146	    (directLimitQuotientToIdeal f K hK read J hreadK hread) ⟨by
   147	      have hker : ∀ z,
   148	          directLimitQuotientToIdeal f K hK read J hreadK hread z = 0 → z = 0 := by
   149	        intro z hz
   150	        obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := Module.DirectLimit.exists_of z
